content: To explore translation quality, consider pair of sample translations provided by two models. For example, against an Italian query, medaglia oro super vinse medaglia oro super olimpiadi invernali lillehammer, translated term set from our model is {gold, coin, super, free, harmonising, won, winter, olympics}, while transformer output is {olympic, gold, one, coin, super, years, won, parliament, also, two, winter}. Term set from human translation is: {super, gold, medal, won, lillehammer, olypmic, winter, games}. Transformer comes up with terms like parliament, also, two and years that never appears in human translation. We found that these terms are very likely in Europarl and rare in CLEF. Our model also generates terms such as harmonising, free, olympics that not generated by transformer. However, we found that these terms are equally likely in Europarl and CLEF.
